text: MiniMax put the weights of M3.1 Flash on Hugging Face. It's a 428 billion parameter model with 23 billion active per token and a 1M token context. MiniMax says it scores 62.8 on Automation-Bench, above Opus 5 at 50.3. Free for non-commercial use.
